title: McGill 1993: moment arm estimated of quadratus lumborum at L2-L3 (M, supine)

imaging.modality: MRI Philips Gyroscan, spin echo TR 500 TE 20
imaging.plane: transverse slices (scanner axial, trunk in anatomic supine position); for each level the slice closest to the disc centre (within 5 mm)
imaging.level_definition: disc level: column labelled with the vertebra above the disc (e.g. "L3" = L3/L4), inferred from Table 5 which uses disc labels

quantity.name: moment_arm_estimated
quantity.definition: moment arm NOT measured: estimated from imaging centroids combined with assumed/literature lines of action; centroid distance projected perpendicular to the literature fibre line of action (cosine-corrected); no SD

source.authors: McGill SM, Santaguida L, Stevens J
source.sample: 15 young men; healthy, no history of disabling back disease

how_to_simulate: Pose the model supine (lying; lordosis as when lying, no gravity load on trunk) (posture as stated).
For each quadratus lumborum element, compute the moment arm about the L2-L3 joint axis (perpendicular distance from the axis to the line of action, or -dL/dtheta).
Compare per element/fascicle or force-weighted mean with the measured values.

subject_model.source: Methods (SD age 3.6, weight 10.7, height 6.8); disc area Table 2

extraction.check_notes: Table 5 read from rendered page 177 (disc labels printed).
